tagline: The ai transcribe() SQL function transcribes an audio file into text.
what_it_does: The ai transcribe() SQL function transcribes an audio file into text. It returns the transcript as time stamped segments, and labels each segment with a speaker when speaker diarization is enabled for your workspace. The output is a VARIANT value, so you can chain it into other AI Functions.
why_it_matters: Data security Your document data is processed within the Databricks security perimeter.
